LanguageData.RKU_Apparel_CaptainCloak.label: Partisan Leader Cloak
LanguageData.RKU_Apparel_CaptainCloak.description: The thick cloaks favoured by partisan commissars offer some degree of defence against ranged attacks, though they are rather heavy.
LanguageData.RKU_Apparel_CaptainUniform.label: Partisan Commissar Uniform
LanguageData.RKU_Apparel_CaptainUniform.description: The uniforms of the partisan commissars, who are responsible for political propaganda, morale encouragement, and mechanical repairs.
LanguageData.RKU_Apparel_EliteScoutUniform.label: Partisan Elite Scout Uniform
LanguageData.RKU_Apparel_EliteScoutUniform.descriptio: Elite Scout Uniforms, crafted from special Devilstrand fabric, are expensive and powerful, yet remain remarkably lightweight.
LanguageData.RKU_Apparel_InvaderBag.label: Radio Backpack
LanguageData.RKU_Apparel_InvaderBag.description: A portable radio for communicating with the Ratkin Underground High Command, which can also be used to call in a burrowing assault.
LanguageData.RKU_Apparel_InvaderUniform.label: Partisan Uniform
LanguageData.RKU_Apparel_InvaderUniform.description: Uniform of the Ratkin Underground Partisans, who form the main combat troops of the partisan forces. They provide support from behind teammates using mid-range weapons, while also being responsible for conducting infiltration operations against enemy bases.
LanguageData.RKU_Apparel_ScoutUniform.label: Partisan Scout Uniform
LanguageData.RKU_Apparel_ScoutUniform.description: Uniform of the Partisan Scouts, made from coarse yet lightweight materials. Pity they don't have leisure time for playing baseball.
